tutorial.invite.title: Quick tour?
tutorial.invite.body: We'll walk you through Apolos's main features in under a minute.
tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to Apolos
tutorial.welcome.body: A social, minimalist way to read the Bible with friends. We'll show you the essentials — you can skip anytime (Esc).
tutorial.logo.title: Your home
tutorial.logo.body: Click the logo any time to go back to reading.
tutorial.search.title: Search the Bible
tutorial.search.body: Open the command palette with {{modKey}}K to jump to any book, chapter or verse.
tutorial.bible.title: Bible
tutorial.bible.body: Return to your reading and change book or chapter from here.
tutorial.favorites.title: Favorites
tutorial.favorites.body: Star verses you love and return to them from here.
tutorial.notes.title: My Notes
tutorial.notes.body: Write private or public notes on any verse. Find all your notes here.
tutorial.studies.title: My Studies
tutorial.studies.body: Your shared study sessions with friends — active and past — show up here.
tutorial.newStudy.title: New Study
tutorial.newStudy.body: Start a collaborative study session: shared canvas, sticky notes, verses, and live chat.
tutorial.marketplace.title: Marketplace
tutorial.marketplace.body: Discover public studies from the community and save the ones you want to explore later.
tutorial.friends.title: Friends
tutorial.friends.body: Add friends to invite them to studies, see their presence, and share notes.
tutorial.chats.title: Chats
tutorial.chats.body: Keep your direct and group conversations in one place. Open a conversation to write from a floating chat bubble.
tutorial.chat.title: Chat
tutorial.chat.body: Direct and group conversations. Drop verses into messages with a quick command.
tutorial.profile.title: Profile & settings
tutorial.profile.body: Manage your profile and open Settings to customize reading, privacy, notifications, accessibility, and data.
tutorial.reading.title: Your reading
tutorial.reading.body: Select verses to highlight, copy, bookmark or annotate. Right-click for more actions.
tutorial.toolbar.title: Reading tools
tutorial.toolbar.body: Chapter commentary, version comparison, and cross-references — all from this bar.
tutorial.tabs.title: Workspace
tutorial.tabs.body: Keep multiple readings, studies, and pages open, or split the workspace to view them side by side.
tutorial.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
tutorial.shortcuts.body: Apolos is keyboard-first: J/K for verses, ←/→ for chapters, {{modKey}}K to search, ? to see all shortcuts.
tutorial.done.title: You're set
tutorial.done.body: That's the gist. Press ? any time to see shortcuts. Enjoy your reading.
